title: KREMLIN malware installs secret extensions in Chrome and Edge to steal accounts. A new banking malware operation is being used to
content_md:
KREMLIN malware installs secret extensions in Chrome and Edge to steal accounts. A new banking malware operation is being used to force installation of malicious extensions in Chrome and Microsoft Edge. According to an alert from Elastic Security Labs, the threat bypasses Chromium integrity mechanisms and loads invisibly into the browser, assuming it was approved by the user, with the goal of stealing credentials and sensitive data.

via Mastodon https://tugatech.com.pt/t91166-malware-kremlin-instala-extensoes-secretas-no-chrome-e-edge-para-roubar-contas
